svg.title: Transporting probability mass
svg.desc: A deterministic equal-area disk point set is mapped radially into a nonconvex star-shaped domain. These are illustrative draws, not samples from a trained GFM model.
svg.metadata: Analytic radial homeomorphism: Φ(ru)=r R(u)u, Φ(0)=0. Reference disk is the Euclidean unit ball. Convex target: (x/1.18)^4+(y/.82)^4 ≤ 1. Nonconvex target: 0≤r≤1+.25cos(3a).
